title: UsageWindow

window.description: The window, in the provider's words: five_hour, seven_day, model_scoped:<model>, extra_usage.

utilisation.description: How much of the window is used, 0 to 1 and beyond; null when the provider does not say.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

resetsAt.description: When the window rolls over; null when the provider does not say.

anyOf.description: The latest rate-limit verdict a run of the account reported for the window (plan.limit): allowed, warning (near the limit) or rejected (refused until the reset, whatever the utilisation reads).

verdict.description: The latest verdict a run reported for the window, folded in after the read; null when none has been heard since.

observedAt.description: When this window's numbers were observed: the reading's readAt, or the instant of a run's report folded into it since, which is never before readAt. What a client pooling two readings of one identity compares per window.

description: One plan window of an account's reading: how much is used, when it resets, and the latest verdict a run reported for it.
